name: cecs327-distributed-lodging
description: CECS 327 Distributed Lodging — Node HTTP microservices + React UI + Cloudflare Worker/D1

scripts.services: concurrently -k -n property,payment,reservation,gateway -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "npm run property" "npm run payment" "npm run reservation" "npm run gateway"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n property,payment,reservation,gateway,frontend -c blue,magenta,green,yellow,cyan "npm run property" "npm run payment" "npm run reservation" "npm run gateway" "npm run frontend"
scripts.cf:install: npm install --prefix cloudflare && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.cf:dev: npm run cf:build && npm run dev --prefix cloudflare
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run cf:build && npm run deploy --prefix cloudflare
